import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions.sentence_transformers import embed
from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

# Initialize pixeltable
pxt.create_client()

# Access the docs table
docs = pxt.get_table('docs')

# Create embedding column using sentence-transformers UDF
docs['content_embedding'] = embed(docs['content'], model='all-MiniLM-L6-v2')

# Create vector index for semantic search
docs.create_index('content_embedding_index', column='content_embedding')

# Get query embedding
model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
query_embedding = model.encode('climate change policy')

# Perform semantic similarity search
from pixeltable import select, col
results = docs.select(
    col('content'),
    col('content_embedding').similarity(query_embedding).alias('similarity')
).order_by(-col('similarity')).limit(5)

# Display results ranked from closest to farthest
df = results.to_pandas()
for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    print(f"{idx + 1}. {row['content']} (similarity: {row['similarity']:.4f})")
